text:
lina: Quick doc PR check: adding a short migration note for audit export SDK rename and a sanitized example for the REST export. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1512
matt: paste the examples here so I can check for PII risks
lina: REST curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports" \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"filter":{"start":"2024-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2024-02-28T23:59:59Z"},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<YOUR_BUCKET>"}}'
```
sophie: Good. Add a one-line warning above examples: "Examples use masked/internal IDs; do not include real emails or PII." Also note timestamps are UTC (Z).
lina: Will add. SDK snippet (JS):
```js
// old: client.audit.exportLogs()
const job = await client.audit.startExport({
  filter: {start: '2024-02-01T00:00:00Z', end: '2024-02-28T23:59:59Z'},
  destination: {type: 's3', bucket: '<YOUR_BUCKET>'}
});
console.log(job.id);
```
matt: change bucket placeholder to <S3_BUCKET> and mention RBAC: only org admins can start exports. Also avoid example ARNs or creds.
ops-bot: Policy reminder: public docs must not contain real IPs, emails, SSNs, or credential examples. Use placeholders.<thumbsup:>
sophie: Another small doc fix: the Console anchor is now #exports not #exporting. Lina please update the link and add a short sentence: "Saved old links should redirect to the new anchor."
lina: Done in my branch. I also added a single sentence: "Retention changes are recorded as policy.update events in the audit log; see /docs/compliance/retention for details." I'll push the updated commit in ~10m and ping for final quick review.
matt: LGTM after those edits. Thanks for keeping examples clean.
ops-bot: Pre-merge check: PR 1512 will be scanned for PII and anchor validity on push.
